name: Teens Read it First
what_you_do: Read a new teen book before it comes out. Rate it out of five stars and write a review of under 250 words. Good reviews are posted in the library catalogue.
who_can_apply: Teens who live in Vancouver. The page does not give an age range.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You get one community service hour for every 100 pages of the book, confirmed by letter.
duration: At your own pace, one book at a time
deadline_text: No deadline. Books go first come, first served.
how_to_apply: Watch the teensatvpl Instagram for featured books. Ask for one by Instagram message or at teens@vpl.ca. Pick it up at your nearest branch, then email your rating and review to teens@vpl.ca.
notes: Share your opinion of the book, not a summary of the plot. Reviews of only one or two lines are sent back for more detail.
